Maria (People Ops): Quick heads-up — we are running a pilot backup childcare stipend for the SF + PDX onsite week (Apr 6–10). If you need day-of backup care or extra childcare so you can attend, Redwood will reimburse up to $150/day (max $600 for the week). Book through our vetted providers or submit receipts to expenses. See details and links below.
Lina (Eng): This is great news 😭. Does it cover last-minute closures at my regular daycare?
Maria (People Ops): Yes — covers licensed backup providers, short-term drop-in care, and paid nanny/au pair time hired specifically for the days of the onsite. Not intended to replace regular monthly tuition. If your daycare cancels and you hire backup to make the onsite, that counts.
Jordan (Finance): Reimbursement workflow: please use expense code `POPS-CHILD-2026` and add project tag "onsite-care". Attach the itemized receipt and provider contact. We will fast-track approvals for expenses dated Apr 6–10.
Facilities Bot: Booking portal (vetted vendors): https://rwd.co/onsite-childcare — providers have been pre-screened for background checks and liability. If you want privacy-only booking, tick the "People Ops only" checkbox on the form.
Sam (Platform): Quick Q — partner/spouse/caregiver who comes with me and I reimburse them myself — eligible?
Maria (People Ops): If you pay an outside provider (not on Redwood payroll), yes. For family members (partner/grandparent) we can reimburse up to $100/day for this pilot but need a signed attestation (brief form). DM me and we'll walk you through it.
Lina (Eng): What about contractors and vendors who are parents?
Jordan (Finance): Contractors on 1099 or through vendor invoices are not eligible for this pilot. We can evaluate expanding next quarter based on uptake.
Maria (People Ops): To enroll: please fill this short form by Mar 29 -> https://rwd.co/care-pilot. We have capacity for the first 120 requests; prioritization goes to caregivers traveling to attend onsite.
Sam (Platform): Thanks, filling it out now.
Maria (People Ops): One more operational note — include the provider's name, dates, and total in the expense form. For the expense code, copy/paste: ```POPS-CHILD-2026```
Jordan (Finance): Tax note: reimbursements under $600 for ad-hoc care in this pilot are being treated as non-taxable benefits per our benefits counsel; we'll send an official FAQ and confirmation after enrollment closes. Receipts still required.
Maria (People Ops): I'll follow up with an email containing the FAQ, the short policy, and the booking link. Thanks everyone — shout if any edge cases and @Maria (People Ops) will help triage.
